title: Super Mario Land
shortDescription: A compact handheld platformer that adapts Mario's movement and pacing to the original Game Boy screen.
highlights: Focused stages designed for short, readable handheld sessions
A distinct world and enemy set that gives the handheld entry its own identity

signals.label: GameAtlas handheld selection
signals.rationale: A high-confidence original Game Boy starting point: its focused stages show how the platform adapted a familiar Nintendo action language to a compact handheld format.
